description: Invites 1 to 20 people by email to this organization as members: each gets a mail with a link to join, good for 7 days. Use it only when the user asks to invite someone by email; for a link to paste or to share a research, use team_invite_link. Nothing is sent before the user says yes in their app's confirm box; an app with no confirm box sends nothing, and the user invites from the dashboard instead. Works for an owner or admin of the organization. The answer says for each address whether it was invited or refused, and why.
name: invite_teammate
title: Invite teammates
